name: Kentucky Native Plant Society Rare Plant Restoration Grant
summary: Small grants for propagating or restoring rare plants in Kentucky, open to anyone working on rare plant conservation, with preference for species of greatest conservation need.
reporting: Grant recipients give the society a short summary of the funded work for its newsletter within a year of the grant and are expected to present it at a society meeting or symposium.

geography.quote: The Rare Plant Restoration Grant program will provide up to $500 for the propagation and/or restoration of rare plants of Kentucky.

access.quote: If one is interested in applying for one of these grants, please send a query to grants@knps.org.

amount.quote: The Rare Plant Restoration Grant program will provide up to $500 for the propagation and/or restoration of rare plants of Kentucky.

reporting.quote: Grant recipients are required to provide the KNPS with a short summary of the funded research suitable for publishing in the Society's newsletter, The Lady Slipper, within one year of receiving the grant. Grant recipients are also expected to present their work at the KNPS Fall or Spring meeting or the Kentucky Botanical Symposium
